about: First-run defaults for the Loop Soul film's story data (migration 168). Loaded by `npm run film:seed`, which never overwrites a row the owner has edited. Every entry starts as a draft: nothing here reaches a guest until the owner approves it at /loop/admin/film. Field colours come from src/lib/loop/film/palette.ts; lag frames and Welcome's take-off come from data/loop/film/shape.json.

world.name: Recoolman
world.line: He was Mitus. Then he was given a name.

world.name: The badge
world.line: It sits on the heart. It is not taken. It is given.

world.name: The ground
world.line: Everyone here was taken from it.

world.name: The shadow
world.line: It keeps his time. Not always.
